suite: annotate top bar + entry context (auto-filter, see-through)
expect_red: unticking See-through parts makes the body solid, now

mutations.contract: The see-through switch applies to the parts that are ALREADY open, not just to the next arrival -- for both entry shapes (one element, and a whole study or topology).
mutations.note: The mutation keeps the setting, the persistence and the checkbox state and drops only the re-application to open parts. The reader ticks the box, it stays ticked, it survives a reload, and nothing on screen changes -- which is exactly the shape a guard reading the setting rather than the material would miss.
